section_role: related work / dataset description and method overview

method_evidence.claim: 3D VAE encodes point cloud to latent VecSet and decodes to SDF field
method_evidence.anchor: Given an input point cloud $P \in R^{N \times (3 + C)}$ sampled from the mesh surface, where $C$ denotes surface normals, 3D VAE first extract point features and then obtain the corresponding latent vector set $Z \in R^{L \times d}$ via resampling from estimated distribution... Subsequently, a decoder is applied to reconstruct the signed distance function (SDF) field $F_{sdf}$

method_evidence.claim: Diffusion model uses image encoder and DiT layers for conditional generation
method_evidence.anchor: It first leverages an image encoder, such as DINO-v2~\cite{}, to capture image embeddings $c_i$ and then exploits the multi layers of DiT to predict the added noise or velocity.

formula_evidence.name: VAE encoding-decoding
formula_evidence.meaning: Encoder maps point cloud P to latent VecSet Z; decoder maps Z to SDF field

formula_evidence.name: Flow matching training objective
formula_evidence.meaning: Training objective for flow matching model used in Hunyuan3D 2.1, transforming noise to data conditioned on image embeddings
